declared_mechanism_criterion.definition: Bytes written to app preferences/storage attributable to home-list persistence per load-more cycle, from disk/filesystem trace activity (write sizes grow with list length in unfixed, stay constant in fixed).
declared_mechanism_criterion.comparison: unfixed: write size per load-more grows linearly with accumulated pages (total write volume quadratic in pages); fixed: writes only at first-page fetch. unfixed_total_write_bytes > fixed by >= 3x after 10 pages; unfixed resident memory higher.

negative_bound.reason: Any complete valid fixed ten-page run includes this nonnegative prefix. Even zero bytes on every remaining fixed page cannot reach 3x.

measurement_scope: Actual complete persistent_storage file write returns in normal home load-more cycles; shared cookie/inactive-cache traffic is retained, not subtracted or estimated.
